1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; __the processor__ accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and __the processor__ making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, __wherein the method comprises using a computer system to perform at least one of the determining, accessing, receiving, accepting, or making steps, and wherein the method is not a purely mental process__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step, __and wherein the pre-determined period of time is determined by the processor based on stored data__.

3. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the processor verifies eligibility of the recipient based on the biometric user authentication history__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, __and wherein the processor accesses transaction records from a payment network database__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, __and wherein the processor retrieves authentication records associated with the mobile device from the data store__.

8. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient.

9. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient.

10. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; __the processor__ comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; __the processor__ making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and __the processor__ requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, __wherein the method comprises using a computer system to perform at least one of the determining, accessing, comparing, making, or requiring steps, and wherein the method is not a purely mental process__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days, __and wherein the processor automatically compares the time interval against the pre-determined permissive time interval__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours, __and wherein the processor automatically compares the time interval against the pre-determined permissive time interval__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the processor verifies eligibility of the recipient based on the biometric user authentication history__.

14. (Currently Amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, __wherein the processor executes the program instructions to perform at least one of the determining, accessing, receiving, accepting, or making functions, and wherein the functions are not purely mental processes__.

15. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing, __and wherein the processor determines the pre-determined period of time based on stored data__.

16. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

17. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

18. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the processor verifies eligibility of the recipient based on the biometric user authentication history__.

19. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, __and wherein the processor accesses transaction records from a payment network database__.

20. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, __and wherein the processor retrieves authentication records associated with the mobile device from the data store__.
